title: Donald L. Staheli
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young man
Married Afton Stratton 1952, St. George Utah Temple; four children
High Councilor, Counselor in Bishopric and two Stake Presidencies
First President of the new Draper Utah Temple, 2009-2010.
